name: Kum Brian Ihimbru
title: Full-Stack Application Developer
summary: Application developer experienced in building mobile apps, enterprise web interfaces and backend services across environmental technology, fisheries commerce, HR, payments and trading. Hands-on with React Native/Expo, Flutter, Kotlin, Nuxt.js, Next.js and Java/Spring Boot.
intro: I build practical mobile apps, enterprise web platforms and backend services. My work spans air-quality monitoring, fisheries marketplaces, HR systems, payments and trading tools.
about: I am a full-stack application developer and Computer Science graduate of the University of Buea. At DHI, I progressed from an internship to a full-time application-development role, working across mobile, frontend and backend development. I also build independent client websites that make specialized organizations and their content easier to discover and manage.
